title: fix: accessibility pass issues
body:
## Changelog Entry

### Fixed

- Improved accessibility across multiple components, in PR [#5428](https://github.com/microsoft/BotFramework-WebChat/pull/5428), by [@OEvgeny](https://github.com/OEvgeny)
  - Fixed copy button screen reader announcement
  - Added proper ARIA attributes to link definitions component
  - Improved focus management for scroll to end button

## Description

This PR addresses several accessibility issues to improve user experience for screen reader users and keyboard navigation.

## Design

The improvements are implemented through several targeted changes:

The copy button implementation now incorporates live region announcements for copy operations in addition to fixed visibility of the button name.

Link definitions now has all required ARIA attributes.

The scroll to end button moved out of the transcript area to better support natural focus order. The positioning logic has been elevated to the container level.

## Specific Changes

- Updated `ActivityCopyButton`:
  - Added `visibility: hidden` to visually hidden elements
  - Implemented copy success announcement

- Enhanced `LinkDefinitions`:
  - Added `aria-controls`, `aria-expanded`, and `aria-pressed`
  - Implemented proper button role

- Refactored scroll to end button:
  - Created new `ChatHistoryBox` and `ChatHistoryToolbar` components
  - Moved positioning logic to container level CSS

- Optimized `FocusTrap`:
  - Removed redundant `getTabbableElementsInBody` call

- Fixed tests

Related commits:

- [fix: copy button announced text](https://github.com/microsoft/BotFramework-WebChat/commit/5ba60993c4c98d74ee66bda690bdcbca2b0ce9dc)
- [fix: link definitions missing aria](https://github.com/microsoft/BotFramework-WebChat/commit/5ea2b5f72712a2c2b649b4d5131f7340b2bada14)
- [fix: focusables redundant calculation](https://github.com/microsoft/BotFramework-WebChat/commit/bd979337f878f216a4c3e259fc5ebefa9685370c)
- [fix: scroll to end button focus order](https://github.com/microsoft/BotFramework-WebChat/commit/87a0c7098781ca1b2b620ed6daef097162efbb48)

<!-- For bugs, add the bug repro as a test. Otherwise, add tests to futureproof your work. -->

- [x] I have added tests and executed them locally
- [x] I have updated `CHANGELOG.md`
- [x] ~I have updated documentation~

## Review Checklist

> This section is for contributors to review your work.

- [x] Accessibility reviewed (tab order, content readability, alt text, color contrast)
- [x] Browser and platform compatibilities reviewed
- [x] CSS styles reviewed (minimal rules, no `z-index`)
- [x] Documents reviewed (docs, samples, live demo)
- [x] Internationalization reviewed (strings, unit formatting)
- [x] `package.json` and `package-lock.json` reviewed
- [x] Security reviewed (no data URIs, check for nonce leak)
- [x] Tests reviewed (coverage, legitimacy)
